senses.gloss: m. (חסחס, Pilp. of חסם, v. חוּס a. preced. art.) [projection, protection,] the cartilages forming the ear, helix &c.
units: Bekh. VI, 1 (37ᵃ) נפגמה אזני מן הח׳ (ed. חסחום; Mish. ed. a. Ar. הסּחוֹס) if its ear it split (defective) from the cartilages (inward).—Pl. חִסְחוּסִים, סִין … gristles.

<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 7:11">Pes. VII, 11</cite> (<cite ref="Pesachim 84a">84ᵃ</cite>) Y. ed. (Mish. a. Bab. ed. <he>הַסְּחוּסִין</he>; Ms. M. 2 also <he>הסחיסין</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 30).—Y. Snh. VIII, beg. 26ᵃ <he>אכלו הסוקים</he>, read: <he>אכל ח׳</he>.—V. <he>חַסְחָסִית</he>.
